Please review the plan, charges, service restrictions and privacy terms before signing. The accepted application and order summary record the plan selected by the subscriber.

1. Service and activation

The provider will process activation after identity verification and acceptance. The assigned mobile number will be recorded upon activation. Voice, messaging and data availability depend on network coverage, device compatibility and the selected plan.

2. Plan and billing

Monthly feeAFN 500Credit limitAFN 1,500

The provider issues an itemized bill showing plan charges, additional usage and the payment due date. Any applicable taxes, out-of-plan charges and deposit settlement terms are stated in the accepted order summary. The credit limit may trigger usage restrictions. Billing disputes may be raised through AsiaInfo customer support.

3. Subscriber and provider responsibilities

The subscriber supplies accurate identity and contact information, keeps the SIM and account secure, reports loss or suspected misuse, and pays invoices when due. The provider provides support for activation, billing and service faults and communicates planned service interruptions where practicable.

4. Service restrictions, changes and termination

The provider may restrict service for overdue payments, suspected misuse or security incidents, with notice where practicable. The subscriber may request a change or cancellation through customer support. The provider will communicate applicable changes, the effective date and any remaining balance, and account for the deposit in the final settlement.

5. Identity verification and records

The subscriber supplies valid identification and any supporting documents required for registration. The provider uses these records to verify identity, activate service, administer the account and meet applicable recordkeeping obligations. Access to registration records is limited to authorized personnel and permitted recipients.

6. Privacy and complaints

The subscriber may contact AsiaInfo customer support to ask how account data is used, request correction of inaccurate information or raise a complaint. Registration records are retained under the applicable retention policy. Marketing preferences are recorded separately from service acceptance.

7. Acceptance and signatures

The subscriber confirms that the selected plan, charges and terms have been reviewed. Service begins when the provider accepts the application and activates the SIM.
